rachats.citation: Acquisition of Terminal and Retail Locations in New York During the third quarter of 2019, we acquired a 900,000 -barrel capacity light product and asphalt terminal and 33 NOCO Express retail stores in Buffalo, Syracuse and Rochester, New York, from NOCO Incorporated for total consideration of $ 135 million .
